notes.title: Version 1.26
notes.content:
Salute, Heroes!

We have made considerable improvements to the game over the past few days based on your feedback - 

-Fixed an issue with consumables not stacking correctly.
-Fixed various other issues with consumables.
-Fixed an issue with King Dragon not appearing in the dragon themed times mission.
-Increased the saving frequency in Season Mode so that if the game crashes users should not lose progress.
-Fixed the text an icons on a number of skills.
-Fixed a bug with users getting stuck in the tutorial.
-Fixed a bug that would prevent the game from saving anything if the user didnt progress through the tutorial correctly.
-Removed showing the users Rank at the end of each mission in non-season mode (rank is still able to be viewed on the leaderboards).

As ever, please posting in the forums as we review every post.

Tool up, heads down, click on!

notes.title: Version 1.25
notes.content:
All hail, brave heroes!

We've continued to listen to the community and make fixes to the game, including - 

- Fixed an issue with using the CTRL key to upgrade 100 skill levels at a time
- Fixed an issue where users could get stuck in the shop overlay
- Added some save data integrity checks to prevent data loss
- Turned off steam cloud sync (temporarily) 
- Fixed an issue with users not receiving the correct end of season reward tiers

Keep posting on the forums as you have been doing. We appreciate the passion you share for our game. 

Until next time..

We have released a new version which addresses the following -

notes.title: Version 1.21
notes.content:
Salute, Heroes!

Our development has had the momentum behind them. Check out these comprehensive fixes in the latest version - 

-Fixed Lifesteal not working on some skills
-Fixed various issues with status effects not resolving to the correct numbers (should improve your overall damage).
-Fixed an issue with the display of armor and resist numbers in the hero stats screen
-Fixed an issue where the displayed hero stats would not update when changing equipment
-Fixed an issue with the duration of the VIP bonus from having 3 friends login during the last day
-Fixed an issue with the shop not loading the first time you try to go there
-Fixed an issue with cloud syncing when using multiple computers.
-The news ticker will no longer localise hero names.
-Added a "Start Mission in Idle Mode" button to the mission setup screen.

As ever, please keep up the forum posts, we are reading every one and then taking the appropriate action.

Jump into the battlefield today.

Click for victory!

notes.title: Version 1.18
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

We continue to improve the overall player experience. Here is what we have resolved in the latest version (1.18).

- Fixed an issue where exceedingly high level skills could cause a crash when triggered
- Fixed an issue where playing the game on multiple computers with Steam Cloud enabled could cause unexpected behaviour
- Fixed an issue where a user could end up in the state where they could no longer upload game data to the server, preventing them from entering Season Mode
- Fixed an oversight where the game was sending too much network data for no real reason
- Filtered some helpful users' data to bring their hero levels back inline with what they'd expect

Remember to Keep on clicking. Victory is ahead of you!

notes.title: Version 1.17

All that before Christmas.

Now go, heroes. Click your way to success in the battlefield!

notes.title: Version 1.16
notes.content:
Another day and we've made another step forward in enhancing the overall player experience. 

Here is what we've achieved in terms of fixes in this latest build -

- Fix - crash bug when opening Inventory / Merchant when you have a large - number of high level items.
- Fix - Daily Login rewards getting reset to day 1.

Keep the discussions coming.

notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.content:
We've continued to listen to the community and made a bunch more fixes - 

-Fixed mouse scroll wheel not working.
-Fixed level based damage bonuses not working (ie, 25% increased damage at skill level 25)
-Capped FPS.
-Doubled texture resolution.
-Fixed a couple of shop issues.
-Fixed friend list not working (Gift a free Healing Potion to your friends once each day!).
-Fixed usernames not showing up on "A Player has found SomeItem".

These last two fixed will take a little while to start showing up, as other users need to update before you can see their names.

We appreciate the ongoing support.

Keep the questions coming in through the Discussion channel.

Click on to victory!
